NFL DFS Defense Rankings: Week 6 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, October 18 · 10 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 13, 9:50 PM ET

The Chiefs are the top-projected defense on the Week 6 DraftKings main slate at 7.6 DraftKings points for $3,600, against the Chargers. Rams (7.4, $3,800) and Patriots (7.2, $3,500) are next.

The Chiefs are also the top value at the position: 2.11 projected points per $1,000.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 13, 9:50 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are published.

Defenses to know in Week 6

Chiefs, KC vs LAC ($3,600)

Chiefs carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 7.6 DraftKings points at $3,600. That is 0.2 points clear of Rams. The salary works out to 2.11 projected points per $1,000, 1st of 7 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Chiefs averaged 7.6 points with a simulated floor of 0.0 and a ceiling of 15.6, and it holds 4% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Kansas City is an 8.5-point favorite at home against the Chargers, with an implied team total of 25.5 in a game totaled at 42.5.

Value: Ravens, BAL at CLE ($3,200)

Ravens projects for 6.7 DraftKings points at $3,200, which works out to 2.10 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 7 defenses the model projects for 6 or more points. Across 10,000 simulations Ravens averaged 6.7 points with a simulated floor of 0.0 and a ceiling of 15.7, and it holds 4% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Baltimore is a 4.5-point favorite on the road against Cleveland, with an implied team total of 23 in a game totaled at 41.5.
